**Bishwo.com** is a science site about space, the Earth and the universe. It began in Bengali, and this is the English edition: short articles that explain one idea at a time.

## What we write about

- **The Solar System:** planets, moons, asteroids and comets.
- **Stars and the night sky:** how stars are born, measured and named.
- **The Earth:** its interior, plates and the forces that shape it.
- **Cosmology:** galaxies, black holes and the scale of the universe.

Browse by [tag](tags.html) or [category](categories.html), or follow the [RSS feed](index.xml).

## Who writes here

Author profiles, with each author's posts, are on the [author pages](authors/abdullah-al-mahmud.html).

## The Bengali edition

Most of our articles are in Bengali at [www.bishwo.com](https://www.bishwo.com).
